learn.hook: School closes after the 10th for 12 days of holidays. On which date does it reopen?
points: A month calendar has 7 columns, one for each day of the week, and the dates in rows.
To make a calendar, write 1 under the first day of the month and keep counting along the rows.
To list all the dates of one weekday, go down its column: they are 7 apart, like 3, 10, 17, 24, 31.
Count the Sundays by counting the dates in the Sunday column.
Reopening date: if school closes after the 10th for 12 days, the holidays are the 11th to the 22nd, so it reopens on the 23rd.

example.q: A month has 30 days and the 1st is a Monday. How many Sundays are there?
steps: The next would be 35, which is too far.

learn.reallife: Families mark festivals, birthdays and exam dates on a wall calendar.

games.title: Calendar facts
items: Dates in one column of a calendar are 7 apart.
A month with 30 days can have 5 Mondays.
Every month starts on a Sunday.
If the 2nd is a Friday, the 9th is a Friday.

quiz.q: The 1st of a month is a Monday. Which date is the first Sunday?
quiz.explain: Monday 1, Tuesday 2, ... Sunday 7.
steps: Mon 1, Tue 2, Wed 3, Thu 4, Fri 5, Sat 6, Sun 7.

quiz.q: A 30-day month starts on Monday. How many Mondays does it have?
steps: Mondays are 7 apart, starting from the 1st.

quiz.q: A 31-day month starts on Monday. What day is the 31st?
quiz.explain: 29 is a Monday, 30 a Tuesday, 31 a Wednesday.

quiz.q: Dates of all Thursdays in a month are 4, 11, 18, ___. What comes next?
steps: The same weekday comes every 7 days.

quiz.q: School closes after the 10th for 12 days. On which date does it reopen?
quiz.explain: Holidays are 11th to 22nd (12 days), so it reopens on the 23rd.

quiz.q: When making a calendar, the 1st falls on Wednesday. On which day does the 3rd fall?
quiz.explain: Wed 1, Thu 2, Fri 3.

quiz.q: The 6th is a Saturday. What day is the 20th?
quiz.explain: 6 + 7 = 13 and 13 + 7 = 20, so it is also a Saturday.
steps: After whole weeks, the day is the same.
So the 20th is also a Saturday.
quiz.mistake: Counts days one by one wrongly

quiz.q: A shop is shut every Sunday. In a month the Sundays are 3, 10, 17, 24 and 31. How many days is the shop shut?
quiz.explain: There are 5 Sundays.

teach.ask: Gappu's holiday starts after the 5th and lasts 7 days. When does he go back to school?
teach.praise: Holidays are 6th to 12th, so I go back on the 13th! Chirp!

revise.summary: A month calendar has 7 columns, one for each day. Dates in one column are 7 apart, so we can find all the dates of a weekday.
focus: Make a month calendar.
Find all dates of one weekday.
Count holidays and find a reopening date.
remember: Same weekday dates are 7 apart: 3, 10, 17, 24, 31.
30-day month starting Monday: 4 Sundays (7, 14, 21, 28).
Closed after the 10th for 12 days: reopens on the 23rd.
traps: Not every month has 4 of each day. Some have 5.
Don't miss the 31st.
Don't forget the last holiday when counting.

learn.hook: When is your birthday? When is Diwali? A calendar helps us know!
points: A week has 7 days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday.
A year has 12 months, from January to December.
April, June, September and November have 30 days. February has 28 days, or 29 in a leap year. All the other months have 31 days.
A calendar shows the date of each day in a month.
The same day comes again every 7 days. If the 3rd is a Monday, the 10th is a Monday too.

example.q: The 12th of a month is a Thursday. What day is the 19th of that month?
steps: So the 19th is also a Thursday

learn.reallife: We use calendars to plan holidays, festivals, birthdays and exams.

games.title: Months in order
games.prompt: From the start of the year to the end

quiz.q: How many days are there in a week?
quiz.explain: Monday to Sunday makes 7 days.
steps: Days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday.

quiz.q: How many months are there in a year?
quiz.explain: January to December makes 12 months.
steps: Months go from January to December.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up months in a year with days in a week

quiz.q: Which month comes right after June?
quiz.explain: The months go ... May, June, July, August ... So July comes after June.
steps: The months go ... May, June, July, August ...
quiz.mistake: Picks the month before instead of after

quiz.q: How many days does April have?
quiz.explain: April is one of the four months with 30 days: April, June, September and November.
steps: April, June, September and November have 30 days.

quiz.q: Today is Friday. What day will it be tomorrow?
quiz.explain: After Friday comes Saturday.
steps: Days in order: ... Thursday, Friday, Saturday ...

quiz.q: If the 5th of a month is a Tuesday, what day is the 12th of the same month?
quiz.explain: 12 − 5 = 7 days, which is 1 week. So the 12th is also a Tuesday.
quiz.mistake: Counts on 7 days but lands one day off

quiz.q: Which month has only 28 days in most years?
quiz.explain: February is the shortest month. It has 28 days, and 29 in a leap year.
steps: It has 28 days, and 29 in a leap year.
quiz.mistake: Does not know that February is the short month

quiz.q: Kabir's holiday is 2 weeks long. How many days is that?
quiz.explain: 1 week is 7 days, so 2 weeks is 7 + 7 = 14 days.

teach.ask: Gappu wants to know how long a week and a year are. Can you explain the calendar to him?
teach.praise: 7 days in a week and 12 months in a year! I'll mark my birthday now.
teach.nudge: How many days make a week? And how many months make a year?

revise.summary: A week has 7 days and a year has 12 months. Months have 30 or 31 days, and February has 28 (29 in a leap year).
focus: Know the days and months in order.
Know how many days each month has.
Use 'every 7 days' to find a day.
remember: April, June, September, November: 30 days.
February: 28, or 29 in a leap year. Others: 31.
If the 12th is Thursday, the 19th is Thursday too.
traps: Not every month has 31 days.
Don't give the day before when asked for tomorrow.
2 weeks is 14 days, not 9.

learn.hook: Your birthday was on a Monday last year. Will it be on Monday this year too?
points: Some things stay the same every year: the names of the 12 months, their order, and 7 days in a week.
Some things change: the day of the week for a date, and the dates of many festivals like Diwali or Holi.
A year has 365 days. A leap year has 366 days (February has 29 days).
A year has about 52 weeks: 52 weeks is 364 days, and 1 or 2 days are left over.
Because of those extra days, a date usually moves one day of the week ahead next year.

example.q: A year has 365 days. How many full weeks and extra days?

learn.reallife: Diwali comes on a different date every year, but Independence Day is always on 15 August.

games.title: Same every year or changes?
items: Day of the week of your birthday
Day of the week of 1 January

quiz.q: How many days are in a year that is not a leap year?
quiz.explain: A normal year has 365 days.
steps: A year that is not a leap year has 365 days.

quiz.q: How many days does a leap year have?
quiz.explain: February gets an extra day: 366.
steps: In a leap year February gets 1 extra day.

quiz.q: About how many weeks are in a year?
steps: So a year has about 52 weeks.

quiz.q: Which stays the same every year?
quiz.explain: January to December, always in the same order.
steps: The day for a date and festival dates can change.
The months always go January to December.
Answer: The order of the months

quiz.q: Which changes from year to year?
options: The number of days in a week
quiz.explain: Holi follows the moon calendar, so its date changes.
steps: Month names and 7 days in a week never change.
Holi follows the moon calendar, so its date changes.

quiz.q: How many days are left over after 52 full weeks in a 365-day year?
In a leap year, how many days does February have?
quiz.explain: In a leap year February has 29 days.
steps: In a leap year, February has 1 extra day.

quiz.q: Riya's birthday was on a Tuesday this year. The next year is not a leap year. On which day will it most likely be next year?
quiz.explain: 365 days = 52 weeks and 1 day, so the day moves 1 ahead.
steps: The day after Tuesday is Wednesday.

teach.ask: Gappu thinks his birthday is on the same weekday every year. Is he right?
teach.praise: No! 365 days is 52 weeks and 1 extra day, so it moves ahead! Chirp!
teach.nudge: How many days are left after 52 weeks?

revise.summary: Month names, their order and 7 days a week stay the same every year. The weekday of a date and festival dates change.
focus: Say what stays the same and what changes.
Know days in a year and in a leap year.
Find how a date's weekday moves next year.
remember: Year = 365 days. Leap year = 366 days.
52 weeks = 364 days, so 1 day is left over.
A date usually moves one weekday ahead next year.
traps: Don't forget the extra day: 365, not 364.
Holi and Diwali dates change.
A birthday does not stay on the same weekday.

learn.hook: Didi is twice as old as Raju and 10 years older. How old are they?
points: To find age from a date of birth: subtract the birth year from the current year (after the birthday has passed).
Born in 2018, in 2026 after the birthday: 2026 − 2018 = 8 years old.
Puzzle: 'twice as old and 10 years older' means the younger one's age is the 10 years. So 10 and 20.
Every year, everyone gets 1 year older. The difference between two ages never changes.

example.q: Amma was 25 when Mira was born. Mira is 8 now. How old is Amma?

learn.reallife: Birthdays are celebrated with cake and the number of candles tells the age!

items.q: Twice as old and 10 years older: younger?
Twice as old and 6 years older: older?

games.title: Age facts
items: The age gap between two people stays the same every year.
If I am 8 now, I will be 10 in 2 years.
If Didi is twice my age now, she will always be twice my age.
Twice changes, but the gap stays.
Born in 2017, I am 9 in 2026 after my birthday.

quiz.q: Arjun was born in 2018. How old is he in 2026, after his birthday?
steps: Age = current year − birth year (after the birthday).

quiz.q: Didi is twice as old as Raju and 10 years older. How old is Raju?
quiz.explain: If Raju is 10, Didi is 20: twice and 10 more.
steps: Didi is twice as old as Raju, so Didi's age − Raju's age = Raju's age.
Didi is 10 years older, so Raju is 10.

quiz.q: Same puzzle: how old is Didi?
steps: Raju is 10 (the younger one's age is the 10 years).

quiz.q: Mother is twice as old as her son and 30 years older. How old is the son?
quiz.explain: If the son is 30, the mother is 60. 60 is twice 30 and 30 more.
steps: Mother is twice as old and 30 years older.
So the son's age is the 30 years.

quiz.q: Sita is 9 and her brother is 4. How much older is Sita?
Sita is 9 and her brother is 4. In 3 years, how much older will Sita be?
quiz.explain: The gap stays the same: 5.

quiz.q: Nani was born in 1960. How old is she in 2026, after her birthday?
Dev will be 10 next year. How old is he now?

teach.ask: Gappu's mother is twice as old as Gappu and 4 years older. How old is Gappu?
teach.praise: I am 4 and Mother is 8. Twice and 4 more! Chirp!
teach.nudge: How big is the gap between our ages?

revise.summary: To find age, subtract the birth year from the current year after the birthday. Everyone gets 1 year older each year, so age gaps never change.
focus: Find age from the year of birth.
Solve 'twice as old' puzzles.
Know that age gaps stay the same.
remember: Born 2018, in 2026 after the birthday: 8 years old.
Twice as old and 10 years older: ages 10 and 20.
Amma 25 years older, Mira 8: Amma is 33.
traps: Don't add 3 to the gap. The gap stays the same.
Don't halve the gap in 'twice as old' puzzles.
If you will be 10 next year, you are 9 now, not 11.

learn.hook: A birth certificate says 14/11/2018. What does that tell you?
points: Dates are often written day/month/year: 14/11/2018 means 14 November 2018.
The middle number is the month: 01 is January, 11 is November, 12 is December.
From the date of birth, find the age in a year, and the date of the birthday every year (14 November).
Count months between two dates: 5 March to 5 July is 4 months. Count days: 3 June to 20 June is 17 days.
Make your own record: your date of birth, first day of school, and other important dates.

example.q: A birth certificate says 26/01/2017. When is the birthday and how old in 2026 after it?

learn.reallife: Birth certificates are needed for school admission and many forms.

quiz.q: In 14/11/2018, what is the month?
quiz.explain: The middle number 11 is the 11th month: November.
quiz.mistake: Reads the day as the month

quiz.q: Which is 2 October 2019 written as day/month/year?
quiz.explain: Day 02, month 10, year 2019.

quiz.q: Born on 05/09/2016. How old in 2026 after the birthday?
Born on 05/09/2016. On which date is the birthday each year?
quiz.explain: 05 is the day and 09 is September.

quiz.q: How many months from 5 March to 5 July?
quiz.explain: April, May, June, July: 4 months.
steps: From 5 March: 5 April, 5 May, 5 June, 5 July.

quiz.q: How many days from 3 June to 20 June?
Which month is 12 in a date like 25/12/2019?
quiz.explain: The 12th month is December.
steps: In 25/12/2019, the middle number is the month.

quiz.q: Leela started school on 01/06/2022 and was born on 01/06/2018. How many years old was she when she started?
Meera is making her own page of important dates, like a birth certificate. Which of these should she write on it?
quiz.explain: A birth certificate records the date of birth. Meera can also add other important dates, like her first day at school.
steps: Other important dates can be added
quiz.mistake: Does not know what a birth certificate records

teach.ask: Gappu's certificate says 09/03/2019. When is his birthday?
teach.praise: Day 9, month 3: my birthday is 9 March! Chirp!
teach.nudge: Which number is the day and which is the month?

revise.summary: Dates are written day/month/year. From a birth certificate we find the birthday and the age in a given year.
focus: Read and write dates as day/month/year.
Find age from a date of birth.
Count months and days between dates.
remember: Month numbers: 01 January, 11 November, 12 December.
5 March to 5 July = 4 months. 3 June to 20 June = 17 days.
traps: Don't read the day as the month.
Don't put the month first.
Don't count March when counting months from 5 March.

learn.hook: Tick, tock! The clock tells us when to wake up, eat lunch and play cricket. Let's learn to read it!
points: A clock has a short hand that shows the hour and a long hand that shows the minutes.
When the long hand points to 12, it is an o'clock time. Short hand on 3 means 3 o'clock.
When the long hand points to 6, it is half past. Half past 4 is 30 minutes after 4 o'clock.
1 hour = 60 minutes. Half an hour = 30 minutes.
The long hand goes all the way round once in 1 hour.

example.q: The long hand is on 6 and the short hand is between 4 and 5. What time is it?
steps: The long hand on 6 means half past.
The short hand has gone past 4 but not reached 5.

learn.reallife: School starts, trains leave and TV shows begin at fixed times on the clock.

games.title: Read the hands
pairs: Long hand on 12, short hand on 7
Long hand on 6, short hand between 2 and 3
Long hand on 12, short hand on 10
Long hand on 6, short hand between 9 and 10
Long hand on 6, short hand between 6 and 7

games.title: Clock facts
items: The short hand shows the hours.
The short hand is the hour hand.
At half past 3, the long hand points to 6.
Half past means the long hand is on 6.
At 8 o'clock, the long hand points to 8.
At 8 o'clock the short hand points to 8 and the long hand points to 12.

quiz.q: The short hand is on 3 and the long hand is on 12. What time is it?
quiz.explain: The long hand on 12 means o'clock. The short hand on 3 means 3. So it is 3 o'clock.
steps: The long hand on 12 means o'clock.
quiz.mistake: Reads the long hand as the hour

quiz.q: Which hand of a clock shows the hours?
quiz.explain: The short hand shows the hour. The long hand shows the minutes.
steps: The short hand shows the hour.
The long hand shows the minutes.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up the hour hand and the minute hand

quiz.q: How many minutes are there in 1 hour?
quiz.explain: 1 hour = 60 minutes. The long hand takes 60 minutes to go all the way round.
steps: The long hand goes all the way round in 1 hour.
quiz.mistake: Thinks time works in hundreds like money

quiz.q: Riya's school bus comes at half past 7. Where is the long hand?
quiz.explain: At half past, the long hand is halfway round the clock, on 6.
steps: Half past means 30 minutes after the hour.
The long hand is halfway round, on 6.
quiz.mistake: Puts the long hand on the hour number

quiz.q: Cricket practice starts at 4 o'clock and ends at 5 o'clock. How long is the practice?
quiz.explain: From 4 o'clock to 5 o'clock the short hand moves 1 number. That is 1 hour.

quiz.q: The long hand is on 6 and the short hand is between 11 and 12. What time is it?
quiz.explain: The long hand on 6 means half past. The short hand has passed 11, so it is half past 11.
steps: The long hand on 6 means half past.
The short hand has passed 11 but not reached 12.
quiz.mistake: Reads the next number after the short hand as the hour

quiz.q: How many minutes are there in half an hour?
quiz.explain: Half of 60 minutes is 30 minutes.
quiz.mistake: Thinks half an hour is 50 minutes, like half of 100

quiz.q: Arjun wakes up at 6 o'clock. He takes 1 hour to get ready. At what time is he ready?
quiz.explain: 1 hour after 6 o'clock is 7 o'clock.

teach.ask: Gappu looks at a clock and sees two hands. He doesn't know which is which! Can you help him read the time?
teach.praise: Short hand for hours, long hand for minutes! Now I won't be late.
teach.nudge: Which hand tells the hour? And where is the long hand at o'clock?

revise.summary: A clock has a short hand for hours and a long hand for minutes. Long hand on 12 means o'clock; on 6 means half past.
focus: Read o'clock and half past times.
Know which hand shows what.
Find how long something takes in hours.
remember: 1 hour = 60 minutes. Half an hour = 30 minutes.
Long hand on 12: o'clock. On 6: half past.
The long hand goes round once in 1 hour.
traps: Don't read the long hand as the hour.
Half an hour is 30 minutes, not 50.
At half past 11, the short hand is between 11 and 12; it is not half past 12.

learn.hook: Cut a clock face like a pizza into 4 equal slices. Each slice is a quarter of an hour!
points: A clock face can be split into 4 quarters. Each quarter is 15 minutes.
Quarter past 2: the long hand is on 3. It is 15 minutes after 2 o'clock.
Quarter to 5: the long hand is on 9. It is 15 minutes before 5 o'clock.
Each number on the clock is 5 minutes for the long hand: on 1 it is 5 minutes, on 2 it is 10 minutes.
We can also write times like 2:15, 2:30 and 4:45.

example.q: The long hand is on 9 and the short hand is close to 8. What time is it?
steps: The long hand on 9 means quarter to.
The short hand is nearly at 8, so 8 o'clock is coming.
15 minutes before 8 o'clock is quarter to 8, or 7:45.

learn.reallife: Your mother may say 'Be ready by quarter to 9!' Now you will know exactly when that is.

games.title: Morning timeline
games.prompt: Earliest to latest in the morning

items.text: At quarter past, the long hand points to ___.
A quarter of an hour is ___ minutes.

quiz.q: The long hand is on 3 and the short hand is just after 2. What time is it?
quiz.explain: The long hand on 3 means quarter past. The short hand just after 2 means it is quarter past 2.
steps: The long hand on 3 means quarter past.
The short hand is just after 2.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up quarter past (long hand on 3) and quarter to (long hand on 9)

quiz.q: Where is the long hand at quarter to 6?
quiz.explain: At quarter to, the long hand is on 9, 15 minutes before the next hour.
steps: Quarter to means 15 minutes before the next hour.
Then the long hand is on 9.
quiz.mistake: Puts the long hand on 3 for quarter to

quiz.q: How many minutes is a quarter of an hour?
quiz.explain: 1 hour is 60 minutes. Share 60 into 4 equal parts: 15 minutes each.
quiz.mistake: Thinks a quarter of an hour is 25 minutes, like a quarter of 100

quiz.q: Quarter past 4 is the same as ___.
quiz.explain: Quarter past 4 is 15 minutes after 4 o'clock, written 4:15.

quiz.q: Quarter to 9 is the same as ___.
quiz.explain: Quarter to 9 is 15 minutes before 9 o'clock. That is 8:45.
quiz.mistake: Writes the hour as 9 instead of 8

quiz.q: Meena's dance class starts at 5 o'clock and lasts 15 minutes. When does it end?
quiz.explain: 15 minutes after 5 o'clock is quarter past 5.
steps: 15 minutes after 5 o'clock is quarter past 5.
quiz.mistake: Counts 15 minutes backwards instead of forwards

quiz.q: When the long hand is on 4, how many minutes past the hour is it?
quiz.explain: Each number is 5 minutes. Count by 5s: 5, 10, 15, 20.
steps: Each number is 5 minutes for the long hand.
quiz.mistake: Reads the number as minutes instead of counting by 5s

quiz.q: A train leaves at half past 10. Kabir reaches the station at quarter past 10. Is he early or late?
quiz.explain: Quarter past 10 (10:15) comes before half past 10 (10:30). He is 15 minutes early.
quiz.mistake: Thinks quarter past comes after half past

teach.ask: Gappu's mother said 'Come home at quarter to 6.' Gappu is confused. What does 'quarter to' mean?
teach.praise: 15 minutes before 6, with the long hand on 9! I'll be home at 5:45.
teach.nudge: Is 'quarter to 6' before 6 o'clock or after it? Where is the long hand?

revise.summary: A clock face splits into 4 quarters of 15 minutes. Long hand on 3 is quarter past; on 9 is quarter to.
focus: Read quarter past and quarter to.
Write times like 2:15 and 4:45.
Count minutes by 5s.
remember: Quarter past 2 = 2:15. Quarter to 5 = 4:45.
Each number = 5 minutes for the long hand.
A quarter of an hour = 15 minutes.
traps: Don't mix up quarter past (on 3) and quarter to (on 9).
Quarter to 9 is 8:45, not 9:45.
A quarter of an hour is 15 minutes, not 25.

topics.title: Draw the hands, plan the day

learn.hook: Draw the hands for half past 7. Where does the short hand go? Careful!

For half past 7, the long hand points to 6 and the short hand is halfway between 7 and 8.
For quarter past 3, the long hand points to 3 and the short hand is just after 3.
Daily routine: wake up about 6:30 in the morning, school at 8, lunch at 1, play at 5, dinner at 8, sleep at 9.
Match activities to sensible times: we do not eat breakfast at 9 at night!

example.q: Where are the hands at 9 o'clock?

learn.reallife: A daily timetable helps you finish homework and still have time to play.

quiz.q: Where does the long hand point at 5 o'clock?

steps: At o'clock times, the long hand points to 12.

quiz.q: At quarter past 3, where is the long hand?

steps: 9:00 at night is bedtime for most children.

quiz.explain: The short hand points to the hour.
steps: The short hand points to the hour.

quiz.q: At half past 4, where is the long hand?

quiz.q: Ravi's timetable: homework at 4:00, play at 5:00. How long is homework time?
quiz.explain: From 4 to 5 is 1 hour.

teach.ask: Gappu needs to show half past 2 on a clock. Where should he put the hands?
teach.praise: Long hand on 6, short hand between 2 and 3! Chirp!
teach.nudge: Where does the short hand go when it is half past?

revise.summary: To show a time, place the long hand for minutes and the short hand for the hour. Match daily activities to sensible times.
focus: Draw hands for o'clock, half past and quarter past.
Know where the short hand is at half past.
Plan a daily routine with sensible times.
remember: 9 o'clock: long hand on 12, short hand on 9.
Half past 7: long hand on 6, short hand halfway between 7 and 8.
Quarter past 3: long hand on 3.
traps: At half past, the short hand is not exactly on the hour.
Don't confuse quarter past with quarter to.
Don't mix up morning and night activities.

learn.hook: Brushing teeth: 2 minutes. A cricket match: hours. Summer holidays: weeks! Let us sort time.
points: Some events last minutes (brushing teeth), some hours (a school day), some days (a wedding), some months (a season).
Estimate how many minutes everyday things take: bathing about 10 minutes, eating lunch about 20 minutes.
Think what can be done in a given time: in 1 minute you can clap many times but cannot cook dinner.
Read minutes passed from the long hand: from 12 to 3 is 15 minutes; from 12 to 6 is 30 minutes.
Each number on the clock is 5 minutes for the long hand.

example.q: The long hand moves from 12 to 4. How many minutes passed?

learn.reallife: Knowing how long things take helps us get to school on time.

quiz.q: Which takes about 2 minutes?
quiz.explain: Brushing teeth takes a couple of minutes.
steps: Summer holidays last weeks. A school day lasts hours. A train trip takes hours.

quiz.q: Which lasts for months?
quiz.explain: Winter lasts a few months.
steps: A period, combing hair and lunch take minutes.
A season like winter lasts a few months.

quiz.q: The long hand moves from 12 to 3. How many minutes passed?
quiz.explain: 3 numbers × 5 minutes = 15.

quiz.q: The long hand moves from 12 to 8. How many minutes passed?
What can you do in 1 minute?
quiz.explain: Clapping is quick. The others take much longer.
steps: A movie, a big book and a dinner take much longer.

quiz.q: About how long does a bath take?
quiz.explain: A bath usually takes some minutes.
steps: 10 seconds is too short. 10 hours and 10 days are too long.

quiz.q: Reading time: 7:00 to 7:20. How many minutes?
quiz.explain: From 7:00 to 7:20 is 20 minutes.

quiz.q: The long hand moves from 3 to 9. How many minutes passed?
quiz.explain: 6 numbers × 5 = 30 minutes.

teach.ask: Gappu thinks building a nest takes 5 minutes. What would you tell him about estimating time?
teach.praise: Building a nest takes days, not minutes! Chirp!
teach.nudge: Is 5 minutes enough for a big job like that?

revise.summary: Some events last minutes, some hours, some days and some months. Each number on the clock is 5 minutes for the long hand.
focus: Choose minutes, hours, days or months for an event.
Estimate how long everyday things take.
Read minutes passed from the long hand.
remember: 12 to 3 = 15 minutes. 12 to 6 = 30 minutes.
12 to 4 = 4 × 5 = 20 minutes.
Bath about 10 minutes, lunch about 20 minutes.
traps: Don't count numbers as minutes. Multiply by 5.
1 minute is short. You cannot cook dinner in it.
Pick a sensible unit: a bath takes minutes, not hours.

learn.hook: One clock has hands, another shows only numbers. Both tell the same time!
points: An analog clock uses hands to show the time.
A digital clock shows the time in digits: hours, then a colon, then minutes, like 7:30.
7:30 is half past 7. 4:15 is quarter past 4. 9:45 is quarter to 10.
A sand timer lets sand flow from top to bottom. When the top is empty, the time is up.
Make a sand timer with two bottles and time it with a clock: it might take 1 minute.

example.q: A digital clock shows 6:45. Say it in words.

learn.reallife: Microwaves, phones and railway station boards use digital clocks. Board games often use sand timers.

games.title: Clocks and timers
items: A digital clock shows time in digits.
A sand timer tells you the date.
8:00 on a digital clock means 8 o'clock.

quiz.q: A digital clock shows 3:30. What time is it?
quiz.explain: 30 minutes past 3 is half past 3.

quiz.q: How would a digital clock show quarter past 8?
quiz.explain: 15 minutes past 8 is 8:15.

quiz.q: How would a digital clock show quarter to 6?
quiz.explain: 15 minutes before 6 is 5:45.

quiz.q: Which clock uses hands?
quiz.explain: Analog clocks have hands.
steps: A digital clock shows digits. A sand timer uses sand.

quiz.q: A sand timer runs out in 2 minutes. Raju turns it 3 times, one after another. How long in all?
quiz.explain: 2 + 2 + 2 = 6 minutes.

quiz.q: What does 12:00 on a digital clock at lunch time mean?
quiz.explain: 00 minutes past 12 is 12 o'clock.

quiz.q: How do we check how long our homemade sand timer runs?
quiz.explain: A clock tells how many minutes the sand takes.
steps: Start a clock when you flip the timer.
Stop when the top is empty.
The clock tells how many minutes it took.
Answer: Time it with a clock

quiz.q: A digital clock shows 10:05. How many minutes past 10?
quiz.explain: 05 means 5 minutes past.
steps: 10:05: the hour is 10, the minutes are 05.

teach.ask: Gappu sees 7:15 on a digital clock. Where should the hands be on a clock with hands?
teach.praise: Long hand on 3, short hand just after 7: quarter past 7! Chirp!
teach.nudge: Where does the long hand go for 15 minutes?

revise.summary: An analog clock uses hands; a digital clock shows digits like 7:30. A sand timer shows when a time is up.
focus: Read and write digital times.
Change between digital times and words.
Use and test a sand timer.
remember: 7:30 = half past 7. 4:15 = quarter past 4.
9:45 = quarter to 10. 6:45 = quarter to 7.
10:05 = 5 minutes past 10.
traps: Quarter past 8 is 8:15, not 8:45.
Quarter to 6 is 5:45, not 6:45.
05 minutes is 5, not 50.
